columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Credential brokering must isolate provider and shell startup state from project configuration
columns.title_zh: Credential Brokering 必须隔离项目配置对凭据 Provider 与 Shell 启动状态的影响
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260825-008 with Skill 02 score 46/50. When credential brokering is active, project-layer settings that could alter shell snapshots, profile loading or credential-provider environment state are deliberately ignored, while the same settings remain available when brokering is disabled. This creates a bounded trust-boundary question about which configuration layer may influence credential acquisition.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260825-008，Skill 02 评分 46/50。Credential Brokering 生效时，可能改变 Shell Snapshot、Profile Loading 或凭据 Provider 环境状态的项目层设置会被明确忽略，而 Brokering 关闭时这些设置仍被保留。该机制形成了一个边界清晰的信任问题：哪些配置层可以影响凭据获取。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the enabled/disabled brokering branches, the exact project settings suppressed, ownership of credential-provider and shell-startup state, resume behavior and regression tests. Do not generalize this mechanism into a claim that all credential state is isolated from projects.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Brokering 启用/关闭分支、被抑制的具体项目设置、Credential Provider 与 Shell Startup State 的所有权、Resume 行为及回归测试；不得把该机制泛化为“所有凭据状态都与项目隔离”。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Resumed sessions must reconcile uncertain durable writes before new model execution
columns.title_zh: 恢复会话必须在新的模型执行前对不确定的持久写入完成对账
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260825-012 with Skill 02 score 46/50. The SDK persists an uncertain resumed-session append, fingerprints authoritative history and resolves whether that write committed before allowing another model call; changed or ambiguous history fails closed instead of rerunning completed tool work. This is a precise architecture problem at the boundary between durable state, recovery and model execution.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260825-012，Skill 02 评分 46/50。SDK 会持久保存不确定的恢复会话 Append，通过权威 History 指纹判断该写入是否已经提交，并在允许新的 Model Call 前完成对账；History 已变化或存在歧义时 Fail Closed，而不是重跑已经完成的 Tool Work。这是 Durable State、Recovery 与 Model Execution 交界处的明确架构问题。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify pending-append persistence, history fingerprinting, committed/uncommitted/ambiguous branches, the fail-closed repair path, ordering before the next model call and how completed tool work is protected from replay. Do not infer distributed exactly-once semantics beyond the demonstrated session contract.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Pending Append 持久化、History Fingerprint、已提交/未提交/歧义分支、Fail-Closed Repair 路径、下一次 Model Call 前的顺序，以及如何避免重放已完成 Tool Work；不得由该 Session 合同推断分布式 Exactly-Once 语义。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Startup migrations need lock-aware retries and path rediscovery under concurrent rollout mutation
columns.title_zh: 启动迁移需要在 Rollout 并发变更下进行锁感知重试与路径重新发现
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260825-006 with Skill 02 score 45/50. Startup rollout migration now waits for maintenance, re-reads under the writer lock, retries busy rollouts on later startups and rediscovers paths moved by archive/compression while allowing terminal failures not to block cursor progress. The change exposes a concrete recovery design for mutable persisted artifacts under concurrent maintenance.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260825-006，Skill 02 评分 45/50。启动期 Rollout Migration 会等待 Maintenance、在 Writer Lock 下重新读取、把 Busy Rollout 留到后续启动重试，并重新发现因 Archive/Compression 移动的路径，同时不让永久失败阻塞 Cursor。该变更暴露了并发维护下可变持久 Artifact 的具体恢复设计。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the maintenance wait, writer-lock reread, busy-retry persistence, archive/compression path rediscovery, terminal-failure cursor behavior and regression coverage. Keep the conclusion bounded to startup rollout migration rather than general storage transactions.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Maintenance Wait、Writer-Lock Re-read、Busy Retry 的持久语义、Archive/Compression 后的路径重新发现、永久失败时的 Cursor 行为及回归测试；结论必须限定于启动期 Rollout Migration，不得泛化为通用存储事务。
